label: an endpoint with a usage budget in cost units
description: A budget of 600 units per minute, of which at most 200 can be spent at once, as OpenAlex, GitHub and Shopify meter their APIs. A request costs 1 unit, plus 1 for an aggregate (such as COUNT), plus 1 per full 100 result rows. Every response reports the budget in X-RateLimit-* headers; a spent budget gives 429 with Retry-After.

basedOn.source: Shopify GraphQL Admin API rate limits

restrictions.costModelDescription: A request costs 1 unit, plus 1 unit if it is an aggregate query, plus 1 unit per full 100 result rows.
